name: Phosophurs Undetectable Pathfinder
description: Experimental Geometry Dash input tools, configurable click audio, and a five-tab pathfinder interface.

humanised-clicks-enabled.name: Humanised mouse clicks
humanised-clicks-enabled.description: Randomly vary ordinary mouse-click positions. Frame-perfect clicks are never moved.

humanised-click-strength.name: Randomisation radius (pixels)
humanised-click-strength.description: Maximum distance from the intended mouse click position. Set to 0 for no offset.

autoplay-key.name: Toggle autoplay request
autoplay-key.description: Toggles the pathfinder request state. Automated gameplay is not implemented yet.

menu-key.name: Open / close menu
menu-key.description: Opens the mod menu. Default: Z.

click-sounds-enabled.name: Enable click sounds everywhere
click-sounds-enabled.description: Master switch for all keyboard and mouse click sounds.

keyboard-clicks-enabled.name: Keyboard click sounds
keyboard-clicks-enabled.description: Play a keyboard-style click for keyboard inputs.

mouse-clicks-enabled.name: Mouse click sounds
mouse-clicks-enabled.description: Play a mouse-button click for mouse inputs.

waveform-variation.name: Subtle waveform variation
waveform-variation.description: Vary the waveform between clicks while keeping the overall sound consistent.

progress-mistakes-enabled.name: Enable progress-based input variation
progress-mistakes-enabled.description: Configuration only; execution requires the future input scheduler.

progress-start.name: Start percentage
progress-start.description: Level percentage at which future input variation should begin.

mistake-chance.name: Variation probability
mistake-chance.description: Chance from 0 to 100 for an eligible future input to be varied.

show-predicted-path.name: Show predicted path
show-predicted-path.description: Visibility preference for the future path overlay.
